Name: Sema
Description: Hand-authored rulebook for the sema type/enum/format/version-upgrade ontology. Replaces the legacy YAML and ODXML pipelines. See YAML-ODXML-RULEBOOK-MIGRATION-PLAN.md.

Owners.Description: Table: Owners — entities (organizations or individuals) that own Types, Enums, and Formats. Sourced from definitions/owners.yaml.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Owner identifier slug. Example: 'gridworks-energy'. Acts as the primary key.

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: Free-text description of the owner's domain or focus.

schema.name: SupportPolicy
schema.Description: How users get support from this owner (e.g. 'Community support via GitHub issues').

schema.name: License
schema.Description: License under which the owner's contributions are published (e.g. 'MIT').

_meta._CMCC_Summary: Hand-authored rulebook (no Airtable). Source of truth for sema ontology. Tier-1 schema only — Owners is the smoke-test table; other 18 tables follow.
